info.description: Comprehensive API specification for EquiliLearn backend. Includes Authentication, Real-Time Group Chat, AI Document & Slide Summarization (Gemini), and Speech STT/TTS services. All examples and responses are in full English for Apidog, Postman, and Swagger UI.
